arms.directional: Weak-gap projections plus absolute strong-band gap error and paired intact weak-band error
arms.weak-gap: Same paired/absolute emphasis projected onto the weak band in known gaps
arms.whole-gap: Prior twofold paired and onefold absolute spatial gap loss

gradient_match.scope: 48 batches drawn exclusively from the original training set, two known-gap sources per batch, before any update.

training.optimizer: AdamW, .001 to .0001 cosine, 24-update warmup, weight decay .001, per-head gradient cap 2.

weights: EMA for all reported primary comparisons; raw weights and their numerical results are archived.
